title: Human Umbilical Vein Endothelial Cells \(HUVEC) Label Free Single Cell Photonic Fingerprinting
protocol: Place the device in a vacuum for at least 30 minutes to ensure complete and bubble-free filling.
Load PBS buffer with 1% BSA via the loading chamber on the top right section of the biochip to prime it.
Introduce cells via the loading chamber on the top left section of the biochip after priming.
Perform cell capture tests using 20-μm polystyrene beads to emulate cell behavior.
Repeat cell capture tests using HUVEC and EA.hy926 cells.
